//: AUTH-04C: response headers the Authority origin's ingress must send with every static file of apps/authority-web/dist. The gateway (/authority/v1/*) sends its own. Same origin only: no CORS headers, no third-party source.
content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
permissions-policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), publickey-credentials-get=(self), publickey-credentials-create=(self)
